_doc: T-679 guild COLLECTIVE achievements — a shared trophy wall, credited to the GUILD (not double-counted per member) and aggregated from server-validated events. Data-only: a new guild achievement is a new row here (no code change) as long as criteria.event is a guild-scoped event in AchievementProgress.SUPPORTED_EVENTS (guild_kill/guild_gather/guild_quest/guild_member_cap/guild_dungeon_clear/guild_raid_clear/guild_online). Rewards are IDENTITY-ONLY per the T-482 charter and this ticket's explicit anti-guild-hopping / no-power-creep guardrail: the ONLY reward key is `cosmetic` (a guild-earned tabard/crest/regalia at the earned MARQUEE tier the store can never sell) or nothing (a pure trophy-wall entry). There is NO title/coin/power/level reward and NO guild-level gate — the guild-scoped ledger grants NO stat buff, faster XP, cheaper anything, or content-entry key.
